description: This Java class 'LoanItemReader' extends 'AbstractLoanItemReader' and is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.cob.loan' package. It is responsible for reading loan items, specifically during batch processing steps, by retrieving loan IDs based on certain COB parameters, applying locking mechanisms, and preparing data for further processing in a batch job.

classes.name: LoanItemReader
classes.description: A batch component that reads loan IDs for COB processing, handling locking and parameter resolution.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Initialization method called before each batch step to set up the loan IDs to process based on COB parameters and locking status.

methods.name: getLoanIdsLockedWithChunkProcessingLock
methods.description: Retrieves loan IDs that are currently locked with the 'LOAN_COB_CHUNK_PROCESSING' lock owner to prevent concurrent processing.
